airsleek.p: Air flows through the plates, so hair dries and smooths without extreme heat.
Use it straight after the towel in wet mode, or on dry hair for touch-ups.
Thermostatic control keeps the heat steady and never above 160 °C, to help protect hair from heat damage.
Negative ions help keep frizz down for a sleek, glossy finish.
A lock button keeps it closed for storage. The cord turns 360° as you style.

airwave.p: Air wraps each section around the barrel, so curls form without extreme heat. Set them with the cool shot.
The diffuser spreads the airflow gently over natural curls and waves for shape with less frizz.
Fast, focused airflow from a 1500 W motor dries hair without the extreme heat that damages it.
Firm bristles hold tension while warm air, not hot plates, smooths each section straight.
The round brush adds body at the roots and soft bends at the ends.
Long, wide teeth glide through thick or curly hair to smooth it with air as it dries.
